messages:
emma: pushed a small fix to the attention alloc path — should stop a double-free when prewarm and eviction race. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/5421 can someone take a quick look? ideally merge in today's 16:00 PST merge window. @raj @oliver

raj: on it. can you drop a 2-line summary + any perf numbers so i know what to focus on?

emma: summary: move allocation to fast-path and add a light spin-wait to ensure prewarm doesn't free the buffer we just claimed. prevents a rare double-free under high concurrency. code snippet: ```diff
- free(buf);
+ if (cmpxchg(&buf->owner, OLD, NEW)) {
+   free(buf);
+ }
```
microbench (local stress): median +0.5ms for small seqs, tail improved in high-concurrency (p99 down). CI shows one flaky eviction test failing.

maria: i can review after lunch, ping me when CI is green :+1:

oliver: quick q — does this touch kv cache eviction ordering or allocator boundaries for shards? want to make sure we don't change eviction semantics.

emma: it only touches attention alloc path; kv eviction ordering is unchanged. added a comment in the PR about allocator indirection so shard allocators are unaffected. i'll run a short smoke perf with kv loads and paste numbers.

emma: quick perf snapshot: ```
before: p95=32.1ms p99=108.9ms
after:  p95=32.6ms p99=89.3ms
```
(30m canary shows lower tail under contention)

ci-bot: CI status: checks passed except flaky-tests (test-evict-001). https://ci.redwood.dev/build/5421 — rerun flaky?

raj: gave an initial LGTM from me; left one tiny nit about the macro name and asked for an added unit test to reproduce the double-free under stress.

emma: will add the unit test and re-run flaky. plan: merge in 16:00 PST window and run a 30m canary, then promote.

oliver: PTAL from me after maria signs off. canary + monitoring on tail latency makes sense. :rocket:

maria: left a couple small comments in the PR, nothing blocking. i'll approve once tests are green.

emma: thanks all — rerunning flaky-tests now, will update thread when CI fully green and then queue for merge.

ci-bot: rerun complete: all checks green. Merge scheduled for 2172233600 (16:00 PST). Canary job will run for 30m.
